```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "MT and MX are in triode because the reference cascode has no drain headroom: its drain sits near 0.07 V while its Vdsat is about 0.10 V. The bottom devices also have too little Vds margin for matching and Rout. This edit raises the bottom-device margin, lengthens L for gain, and lowers gm/Id to improve Rout. It does not fix the low iin node, which is a remaining risk."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid":   (16.0, 12.0, 22.0),      # nfet gm/Id; lower value -> more intrinsic gain, higher Vdsat
    "L":      (10.0, 4.0, 15.0),       # um, all mirror devices (sets gain / Rout)
    "ymarg":  (0.06, 0.02, 0.10),      # V, extra Vds margin on bottom devices
    "Ib":     (4e-6, 1e-6, 20e-6),     # A, cascode-bias generator current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    iin, iout = spec["iin"], spec["iout_target"]
    g, L = p["gmid"], p["L"]

    # Bottom-device Vds from the reference saturation edge plus margin
    mx0 = lut.size("n", g, L, iin, vds=0.6)
    Y = mx0.vdsat + p["ymarg"]

    # Bottom devices at their actual Vds
    mx = lut.size("n", g, L, iin, vds=Y)
    mo = lut.size("n", g, L, iout, vds=Y)
    gr = mx.vgs

    # Cascode devices sized at their source bias (body effect included)
    mt = lut.size("n", g, L, iin, vds=0.6, vsb=Y)
    mc = lut.size("n", g, L, iout, vds=0.6, vsb=Y)

    vb = Y + mt.vgs
    v2 = vb - mc.vgs

    # Gate generator: diode device with resistor, scaled so MX carries iin at Vds=Y
    kR = lut.op("n", mx.W, L, gr, gr)["Id"] / lut.op("n", mx.W, L, gr, Y)["Id"]
    ma = lut.size("n", g, L, kR * iin, vds=gr)

    # Cascode-bias diode device
    id1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, L, vb, vb)["Id"]
    W5 = max(0.42, p["Ib"] / id1)
    Ib_act = lut.op("n", W5, L, vb, vb)["Id"]

    R1 = (VDD - gr) / (kR * iin)
    R2 = (VDD - vb) / Ib_act

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.dev("MT", "iin", "vb", "y", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MX", "y", "gr", "vss", "vss", mx)
    n.dev("MA", "gr", "gr", "vss", "vss", ma)
    n.dev("MC", "iout", "vb", "v2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("MO", "v2", "gr", "vss", "vss", mo)
    n.M("MB", "vb", "vb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, L, m=1)
    n.R("R1", "vdd", "gr", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vdd", "vb", R2)

    # Predictions
    id_o = lut.op("n", mo.W, L, gr, v2)["Id"]
    iout_err_pct = abs(id_o - iout) / iout * 100.0
    rout = mc.intrinsic_gain * mo.intrinsic_gain / mo.gm
    v_compliance = v2 + mc.vdsat
    power = VDD * (iin + kR * iin + Ib_act)

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": iout_err_pct,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": v_compliance,
        "power": power,
    }
```
